name: resume
title: Résumé / CV
description: A clean one-page résumé with experience, education, skills and languages. Prints neatly to paper or PDF.

placeholders.hint: Your full name as you want visitors to see it. Used in the title, the heading and the footer.
Your job title or the role you're after, e.g. Product designer.
Where you're based, e.g. Lisbon, Portugal, or Remote.
The email address people should write to, shown as the link text. The link is # for now: set it to mailto:your address (the element's data-placeholder-href says what goes there).
A short label for your site or a profile, e.g. yourname.com. Its link is # for now: point it at the real address (the element's data-placeholder-href says what goes there).

placeholders.token: [[Two or three sentences on who you are, what you're good at, and the kind of role you want next]]
placeholders.hint: A short profile summary.
Your current or latest role.
The company or organisation.
When you started the latest role. Replace Present with an end year if you've left.

A concrete piece of work.

When you left.
